svg.title: Figure 15.4 — Landscape Forage Mosaic
svg.desc: Hedgerows, crops, gardens, woodland edges and semi-natural habitat shown as a changing seasonal forage mosaic rather than a fixed-radius uniform circle.
svg.text: Honey bees use profitable patches within the landscape; they do not exploit every hectare equally.

text.tspan: Forage value changes through the year. Record bloom timing and hive response rather than treating a mapped circle around the apiary as
